redfin.remarks: Welcome home to this sleek and stylish residence nestled in the heart of Mar Vista, where modern comfort meets quintessential Westside living! Ideally positioned in one of Los Angeles' most sought-after neighborhoods, this beautifully refreshed home is wonderfully walkable and surrounded by the restaurants, coffee shops, markets and everyday conveniences that make Mar Vista such a special place to call home. Step inside to an inviting open-concept floor plan enhanced by newer luxury vinyl plank flooring and an abundance of natural light. The spacious living areas feel bright, airy and effortlessly connected—perfect for relaxing, entertaining or simply enjoying the easy Southern California lifestyle. The remodeled kitchen is both chic and functional, featuring crisp white shaker cabinetry , stainless steel appliances , gorgeous Caesarstone countertops and a charming mosaic tile backsplash that adds just the right finishing touch. The bathrooms have also been thoughtfully remodeled with contemporary finishes, beautiful tile flooring and a stylish farmhouse sink, creating spaces that feel fresh, modern and move-in ready. With ample parking for both residents and guests, everyday living is wonderfully convenient. And the location is hard to beat—close to everything that makes Mar Vista so beloved, from neighborhood cafés and eclectic dining to local markets, parks and the vibrant energy of Venice Boulevard. You're just minutes from Venice, Santa Monica, Culver City and the beach, giving you the very best of the Westside right at your fingertips. Stylish, bright, beautifully updated and perfectly positioned—this is Mar Vista living at its best!
